I or T: A1 [ I or T ] to hit someone or something with the foot, or to move the feet and legs suddenly and violently
I: › [ I ] If a gun kicks, it jumps back suddenly and with force when the gun is fired.
C2 used to say that you are very annoyed with yourself because you have done something stupid or missed a chance
（由於做了蠢事或錯失機會而）懊惱，自責

C: A2 [ C ] the action of kicking something
C2 [ C ] a strong feeling of excitement and pleasure
極度的快感（或刺激）；極大的樂趣

C usually singular: › [ C usually singular ] informal the strong effect of an alcoholic drink
› [ C usually singular ] informal a new interest, especially one that does not last long

example: I kicked the ball as hard as I could.
我用盡全力踢球。
He was accused of kicking a man in the face.
他被控踢到他人的臉。
She felt the baby kicking inside her.
她感覺到腹中的胎兒在踢她。
When I realized what I'd done I could have kicked myself.
當我意識到自已的所作所為，不禁懊惱不已。
They must be kicking themselves for selling their shares too early.
他們一定為過早拋售股票而懊惱不已。
He gave the ball a good kick.
他使勁踢了一腳球。
I get a real kick out of winning a race.
我從贏得比賽中獲得極大的樂趣。
He was stealing stuff just for kicks (= because he thought it was exciting).
他偷店裡的東西純粹是為了追求刺激。
Watch out for the fruit punch, it has a real kick.
小心這種水果調酒，它很有勁。
He's on an exercise kick (= he exercises a lot) at the moment.
現在他心血來潮愛上了運動。

NONE: › to punish someone or to defeat someone with a lot of force
狠狠教訓

example: We're gonna go in there and kick ass.
我們要去那裡好好收拾他們一下。

NONE: C2 If you kick off a discussion or an activity, you start it.
開始（討論或活動）

example: I'd like to kick off the discussion with a few statistics.
我想以幾個統計數據來開始討論。
Right, any suggestions? Jim, you kick off.
好，有甚麼建議嗎？吉姆，你先說。

NONE: › to refuse to accept something and react strongly against it
反對；反抗

example: As a boy he always kicked against his father's authority.
他小時候總是不服父親的管束。

NONE: › to argue and fight against people in authority
反抗權威
› If something is kicking around a place, it is somewhere in that place, not being used.
被亂丟於；被閒置於

example: There must be a copy of it kicking around the office somewhere.
辦公室的某個地方肯定會有一份副本。

NONE: › to stop doing things and relax
停下來，放鬆

example: What good is life if a guy can’t kick back and watch a good movie?
如果一個人不能放鬆下來看一部好電影，那還叫什麼美好人生？

NONE: C1 to start to have an effect or to happen
開始見效；起作用

example: It takes half an hour for the medication to kick in.
藥片的藥力在半小時後開始顯現。

NONE: › to give something, especially money or help
給予（尤指金錢或幫助）

example: Another plan would require employers to kick in $20 per worker to set up the fund.
另一個項目要求僱主為每個員工拿出20美元來建立基金。

NONE: › If you describe the way someone treats you as a kick in the teeth, you mean that that person treats you badly and unfairly, especially at a time when you need their support.
（尤指在需要幫助時遭受的）惡劣待遇，嚴重打擊

example: She was dismissed from her job, which was a real kick in the teeth after all the work she'd done.
她辛辛苦苦做了那麼多工作之後被解僱了，使她深受打擊。

NONE: C1 If a game of football kicks off, it starts.
（足球比賽）開球，開始
› informal to start to get angry or complain in a noisy way
生氣；吵嚷地抱怨
› US informal to die
死掉
› the time when a game of football starts, or when it begins again after it has stopped because of a goal, etc.
（足球比賽的）開球，開賽，中線開球
› informal the time when an activity starts
（活動的）開始

example: What time does the game kick off?
比賽甚麼時候開始？
See also
kick-off
The children started to kick off so I couldn't stay.
孩子都開始吵嚷地抱怨了，因此我必須走了。

NONE: › to behave badly and show no respect for authority
不受管束；不聽指揮
C1 to force someone to leave a place or organization
開除（某人）；攆走（某人）

example: His wife kicked him out.
他妻子把他攆出去了。
She was kicked out of the squad.
她被小組除名了。

NONE: › to give someone a new job that seems more powerful but is really less powerful, usually in order to stop them causing trouble for you
（通常為制止某人找麻煩而）使（某人）明升暗降
› If you kick ideas around, you talk about them informally in a group.
（在小組中）隨便談一談，非正式討論

example: We need to get everyone together and kick a few ideas around
我們需要聚集各人，一起討論幾個構思。

NONE: › to decide not to do what you had planned to do
取消（計劃）；擱置（計劃）

example: Our plans to buy a new car have had to be kicked into touch now Kev's lost his job.
由於蓋烏被解僱，我們買新車的計劃不得不擱置。

NONE: › to die
死掉
› to give up something harmful that you have done for a long time
改掉舊習慣；戒除惡習

example: She used to be a heavy smoker but she kicked the habit last year.
她過去抽煙很厲害，但去年戒了。

NONE: › to try something or examine it carefully before you buy it
在購買之前精挑細選；仔細檢查

example: Come and kick the tires on this latest version of the software.
過來仔細試用一下這個軟體的最新版本。

NONE: › to become more active or noticeable
變得更活躍；變得更明顯

example: As the storm moves into the desert, the wind and rain start to kick up.
當風暴移動到沙漠時，風雨開始變得更劇烈了。

NONE: › to show great anger about something, especially when this does not seem necessary
挑起事端；（尤指）小題大做

example: He kicked up a tremendous fuss about having to wait.
他因需要等待而大吵大鬧。

NONE: › to do things that you enjoy
輕鬆愉快一番，盡情享樂

example: After final exams we kicked up our heels and had a really good party.
考試後，我們好好輕鬆了一番，開了個很開心的派對。

NONE: › to be forced to wait for a period of time
被迫久等
› very exciting or forceful
非常活躍的；非常強大的

example: They play kick-ass rock and roll.
他們玩一種非常狂野的搖滾樂。

T: › to make the engine of a motorcycle start by forcefully pushing down a metal bar with your foot
› to make something start to happen

NONE: › a metal bar that you push down forcefully with your foot to make the engine of a motorcycle start
（機車的）腳踏起動器

example: Taxes were drastically cut in an attempt to kick-start the economy.
大幅減稅以刺激經濟增長。

NONE: › to criticize or take unfair advantage of someone when they are in a weak position
趁人之危

example: It's typical of the boss to kick someone when they're down.
趁人之危是這個老闆的典型手法。

NONE: › an occasion when a group of people kick a ball to each other for pleasure
（一小群人娛樂性的）踢球
› an amount of money that is paid to someone illegally in exchange for secret help or work
（不合法的）回扣，酬金
› a sport in which two competitors fight by hitting each other with their hands and kicking each other with their feet
跆拳道

C: › someone who kicks, especially a player in an American football team whose job is to kick the ball
踢球者；尤指美式橄欖球中專職踢球的球員

example: And here’s the real kicker - if you buy one you get the second one free.
這裡是真正讓人驚訝的：買一送一。
